description: This file contains unit tests for safe reading operations on file handles in Swift, specifically testing behavior when handles are closed and reading data incrementally.

methods.name: `read to end safely returns empty for closed handle`
methods.description: Test to verify that reading to the end from a closed handle returns an empty data object.

methods.name: `read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle`
methods.description: Test to verify that attempting to read up to a count from a closed handle returns an empty data object.

methods.name: `read to end safely reads pipe contents`
methods.description: Test to verify that reading all data from a pipe returns the expected string.

methods.name: `read safely up to count reads incrementally`
methods.description: Test to verify that reading incrementally up to specified counts returns expected data segments.
